title: LA Galaxy rejects $8m bid for star winger Gabriel Pec from Brazilian club Cruzeiro
content:
The LA Galaxy has rejected a bid for winger Gabriel Pec from Brazilian club Cruzeiro, sources briefed on the situation tell The Athletic.

Cruzeiro bid in the region of $8 million and was told the offer is significantly below anything the Galaxy would even consider to move Pec, sources add.

The Galaxy acquired Pec in 2024 from Vasco da Gama, where he came through the academy, in a deal worth around $10 million. The 25-year-old helped lead the Galaxy to win MLS Cup in his debut season while being named MLS Newcomer of the Year.

Cruzeiro currently sit 11th in Brazil’s Serie A.

Pec had been linked with European interest in previous windows but nothing actionable for the Galaxy. The Brazilian has 43 goals and 28 assists for the Galaxy in 101 appearances, a strong return on investment for the club.

The Galaxy is still without star attacking midfielder Riqui Puig, who suffered a torn ACL in the Western Conference final in 2024, costing him the 2025 season. He suffered a setback last offseason and will miss the entire 2026 season as well.

The Galaxy will be active in the summer transfer window, looking to refresh and improve the team. The club sits ninth in the Western Conference with 20 points after 15 matches. The league took a break for the World Cup and players were given a few weeks off, but teams are back to training now in preparation for the league to resume in July.
